title: External warehouse projection
description: Warehouse registry whitelist without MISA, source, evidence, or audit fields.

warehouse_type.description: Warehouse type, closed set (the ops-core database check constraint): RAW_MATERIAL (raw material warehouse) or FINISHED_GOODS (finished goods warehouse). Upper case, compared byte for byte. Same vocabulary as schemas/ops/warehouse.schema.json.

status.description: Warehouse lifecycle status, closed set. INACTIVE is a lifecycle state, not a deletion: the warehouse stays in the snapshot.
